title: Warpcore v1 Serving Adapter
description:
Schema for a model-specific serving adapter. Permits only model and serving fields. Experiment-level fields (generation ceilings, sampling, tasks, instance sets, denominators, scoring) are prohibited.

Two adapter modes:
- campaign_status=canonical: all immutable identifiers (revision, image) must be 40-hex/digest form.
  These adapters may launch canonical warpcore-v1 campaigns.
- campaign_status=noncanonical: revision and/or image may be 'unresolved' (provenance not yet
  established). These adapters are schema-valid for historical documentation but are BLOCKED from
  launching canonical campaigns by validate_adapter_campaign_ready(). They must carry
  noncanonical_reason explaining exactly which identifiers are unresolved.

campaign_status.description: canonical: all immutable provenance resolved; adapter may launch a canonical campaign. noncanonical: one or more required immutable identifiers are unresolved; adapter is blocked from canonical campaign launch.

noncanonical_reason.description: Required when campaign_status=noncanonical. Names the unresolved field(s) and explains why they cannot be resolved. E.g. 'model_revision_unrecorded: image_digest_unrecorded: historical image tag was eugr/spark-vllm:latest, no digest was retained'.

slug.description: Model slug matching the result-directory name exactly (e.g. qwen3.6-35b-a3b)

id.description: HuggingFace model ID or equivalent canonical identifier

revision.description: Immutable checkpoint revision: exactly 40 lowercase hex for canonical adapters, or 'unresolved' for noncanonical draft adapters.

image.description: Immutable container image identity. For canonical adapters: either a registry manifest reference repo@sha256:<64 lowercase hex>, or a local Docker content-addressed image ID sha256:<64 lowercase hex>. For noncanonical adapters: may be 'unresolved'.

quantization.description: Quantization format (e.g. 'fp8', 'mxfp4') or null for none

reasoning_parser.description: vLLM reasoning parser plugin name or null

tool_call_parser.description: vLLM tool-call parser name or null

tokenizer.description: Tokenizer override or null to use model default

max_model_len.description: Configured context length, or 'unresolved' only for a noncanonical draft adapter.

gpu_memory_utilization.description: GPU memory utilization fraction, or 'unresolved' only for a noncanonical draft adapter.

max_num_seqs.description: Maximum sequence capacity, or 'unresolved' only for a noncanonical draft adapter.

environment.description: Required environment variables and compatibility patches
